scope_note: Names and definitions identify the programme and its scope. They do not establish a validated model or any biological or clinical capability.
release_policy: Each new version replaces the one before it on the main branch; Git history keeps the earlier ones. Experimental previews are published with their known limits. Publishing a version does not mean it has been validated.
license_note: The project's own work is CC0-1.0. The atlas anatomy (CC BY 4.0), Three.js (MIT) and the fonts embedded in the script PDFs keep their own terms. See RIGHTS.md.
development_status: Atlas viewer active; presentation and its scripts paused.
programme_focus: Three projects share the Brain2Body programme: NeuroTranslation, NeuroSurge and Interoceptomics. All three are active.

experimental_model_preview.edition: Brain R8 experimental preview, package R33

package_manifest.scope: Sizes and checksums of the 75 other files in the archive.
package_manifest.historical_inner_record: payload/brain-outward-r6/MANIFEST.json inside the archive is an older record; it describes earlier registry and viewer files.

experimental_model_preview.change: Find a region by name, abbreviation or atlas number and jump to a point inside it on the chosen side.

source_comparison.status: The comparison of region names with the atlas table was made once, on an early edition, and has not been repeated.

experimental_model_preview.limitations: The 3D model holds 121 of the atlas's 141 regions in 44 surfaces: 34 regions have a surface of their own, 82 more are parts of combined surfaces, and 5 are listed by name only. 20 regions have no surface. The source is one population atlas, left half only. Not checked or not claimed: agreement with other specimens, fit to any person, neural function, one planned visual check, and running on Windows, macOS or a phone.

viewer.code_change: Last changed when the three flat cuts through one point were added.

software_checks.kind: Constructed exact-handler two-vertex CPU colour-input fixture; renderer, scene, DOM and camera substituted.
software_checks.historical_scope: Earlier R6 constructed control-fixture evidence. R9 and R10 Chromium observations are separate.

verification_limits.C01: The original AMD/RADV isolate/lateral/deep visual check remains open. R12 checked the resize paths on AMD/RADV under different conditions.
verification_limits.renderer: ANGLE (AMD, Vulkan 1.4.354 (AMD Radeon 8060S Graphics (RADV STRIX_HALO) (0x00001586)), radv)
verification_limits.pending: Broader browser controls, GPU/colour appearance, performance, real-reference SERIES, anatomy, donor/scale/function, rights/privacy, held-out, native visual/export and other OS/browser checks.
verification_limits.earlier_images_and_pixel_results: Earlier images and pixel results describe their original builds and test conditions.
verification_limits.retained_C01_stop: SwiftShader/wrong-window readiness STOP before control actions; original AMD/RADV target and thresholds retained.
verification_limits.startup: R9 test results cover four retained HTTP 404 cases. R12 checked normal startup and a blocked optional red nucleus asset on AMD/RADV and SwiftShader. Other faults and context loss remain open. R14 additionally checked either and both optional files returning HTTP 404 and a VPL checksum mismatch.

experimental_model_preview.launchers: The Windows, macOS and Linux start files need Python 3.10 or newer and a browser with WebGL. The Linux start file served the tested viewer on the local machine. Opening the default browser, and running on Windows or macOS, have not been tried.

startup_error_source_checks.limits: Module import/parse errors, pre-try constants and later asynchronous interaction failures remain outside the repair; exotic thrown-value coercions remain unqualified.

red_nucleus.evidence: Exact atlas-derived geometry independently checked. Comparison to separate MRI and histology remains qualitative.

vpl.evidence: The mesh shows one population-reference atlas boundary. Individual anatomy and neural function require separate evidence.

vpm.evidence: The surface gives one atlas boundary. Individual anatomy and neural function require separate evidence.

vpl_vpm_comparison.face_rule: Count each left annotation voxel face with labels 10424 and 10425 on opposite sides once. Edge and corner contacts are excluded.
vpl_vpm_comparison.evidence_scope: Atlas-label face adjacency in that source version. External tissue and MRI comparison is qualitative.
vpl_vpm_comparison.geometry: VPL and VPM GLB bytes, matrices and original derivation notices remain identical to R15.

shared_face_grid.native_coordinate_frame: Allen v1.0.0 original left, RAS mm. World metres (−R, S, A)/1000.
shared_face_grid.scope: Face-adjacency on the original 0.5 mm Allen v1.0.0 left annotation. Grid faces approximate an atlas boundary. No mesh intersection, individual anatomy, or neural connectivity is measured.

source_sections.native_coordinate_frame: Source-left Allen v1.0.0 RAS mm, world metres (−R, S, A)/1000
source_sections.section_scope: Exact labels 10424 and 10425 at original voxel centres. Other cells masked.

parietal_operculum.source_frame: Original v1.0.0 in ICBM 2009b Nonlinear Symmetric, native RAS millimetres
parietal_operculum.scope: Gross source label. Anatomy only. Histology and touch research are separately cited.

source_sections.scope: All native layers containing PaO, drawing original annotation IDs in each full plane. Only the original left PaO mesh is isolated in the 3D view.

annotation_planes.sampling: No interpolation. The x-fast native label array supplies one exact categorical ID per pixel.

axes.coronal: R increases rightward and S increases upward
axes.sagittal: A increases rightward and S increases upward
axes.axial: R increases rightward and A increases upward

annotation_planes.coordinate_units: NIfTI qform RAS millimetres, at voxel centre
annotation_planes.saved_view_version: atlas-labels-v1 for standard colour, atlas-labels-v2 for a highlighted selection
annotation_planes.mesh_window: Source-left 3D frame. The coordinate cross requires a labelled left voxel.

selected_label.count: Exact native ID across the full registered annotation. Side is classified by RAS voxel centre. Zero is unlabelled. Child IDs are separate.
selected_label.volume: Count multiplied by the absolute determinant of the verified axis-aligned 0.5 mm native qform (0.125 mm³).
selected_label.highlight: Every matching pixel on the three displayed planes, with separate counts per cut.

region_finder.source: Original ID at the native voxel. Midline is voxel-centre R = 0 mm. No alias or descendant substitution.
region_finder.selection: Nearest occupied voxel to the same-ID, same-side centroid in millimetres. Lowest native flat index breaks exact ties.

renderers: ANGLE (AMD, Vulkan 1.4.354 (AMD Radeon 8060S Graphics (RADV STRIX_HALO) (0x00001586)), radv)
package_R33_viewer_check.scope: The original Allen annotation and metadata were checked against all 170 occupied label-and-side combinations across 141 distinct IDs. The 3D preview covers the source left. Sparse source-right labels can be read in the cuts. Linux Chromium checks included the hardware and software renderers, keyboard input, emulated touch, saved views and the ruler. Native Windows, macOS and physical mobile checks remain open.
